conflicts.fact: Which lesson the model is finalised/revised in after v2
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7 Overview says the class adds questions 'in readiness for revising the model in Lesson 6'... actually says 'revising the model in Lesson 10', while its Model Building phase calls it a v2 draft finalised in Lesson 10. This matches the fact sheet (final in Lesson 10), so there is no conflict here.

conflicts.fact: When the water test is done and whether the tray is used for it
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 Predict teacher says 'This is the same kind of tray you will use today' while the learners are told the actual test is in the next lesson. Lesson 2 does the tests.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson taught the classification and model v1
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 teacher says 'Last lesson we classified A to H ... and built model v1' (consistent with Lesson 3). No conflict.
